name: What Destruction Sees
description:
Sera leaves this page blank until you return. She refuses to write another name among the dead.

The Wither can drop this eye. It is optional; you do not have to choose it for your first portal opening. Earn End Remastered's wither eye advancement by obtaining the eye. This record keeps working after you use the eye. Eyes are never consumed by this quest. Loot can be random; choose other routes for the portal if a source proves elusive.
